objectives.description: Implement the G-12 heuristic, count total/documented/undocumented
objectives.note: Prototyped standalone (not yet wired into check-module-invariants.sh, pending resolution below). Result: 10427 total declaration-shaped lines (theorem|lemma|def|structure|inductive|class|abbrev|instance), 9319 documented (/-- ... -/ ending within 3 lines above), 1108 undocumented, 89.37% coverage. Without lemma (direct comparison to research): 10346 total, 89.64%. Both under the 90% floor. Research's own figure: 8982 total, 92.8%.

objectives.description: Verify the sub-90% result is not an implementation bug
objectives.note: Three checks: (a) per-keyword breakdown is sane (def 97.1%, abbrev 96.3%, inductive 96.3%, structure 82.5%, theorem 86.8% [dominant category, 6429 of 10427], instance 57.6%, class 16.3%, lemma 55.6%); (b) manually inspected 8 undocumented theorem hits (BaseLanguage/Formula.lean swapBL_* family, BaseLanguage/Translation.lean tr_* family) -- every one is covered by an enclosing /-! section comment documenting a whole batch of @[simp] rfl lemmas at once, exactly the heuristic's own already-documented blind spot ('under-reports coverage for declarations documented by an enclosing /-! -/ section comment'), not a bug; (c) total declaration count grew ~16% since research measured it (10427 vs 8982), consistent with ongoing development.

objectives.description: STOP and report per the plan's own Scope Hypothesis instruction
objectives.note: Escalated to team lead (msg cbb5ab5b) with the full finding and four options, none of which I chose unilaterally: (a) authorize a heuristic refinement crediting an enclosing /-! section, (b) accept 89.37% as the reported baseline and land C19 with the honest under-90% figure documented, (c) land C19's floor check as reporting-only regardless (it never gates either way) and record the finding, (d) other. Phase marked [BLOCKED] pending response.

deviations.description: Confirm the recomputed figure clears 90% by a comfortable margin
deviations.reason: The recomputed figure does NOT clear 90% -- it lands at 89.37% (with lemma) / 89.64% (without), both below the floor. Verified this is a faithful measurement (not an implementation bug) via a per-keyword breakdown and manual inspection of undocumented samples, which showed the shortfall traces almost entirely to the heuristic's own already-documented /-!-section blind spot rather than genuinely undocumented content. Per the plan's own explicit instruction ('STOP and report rather than lowering the floor to fit -- the floor is the delegation's, not the implementer's'), escalated to the team lead rather than resolving unilaterally.
